segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the updated quote for the 42 seats and make sure the May 20 go-live still works on your side.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, May 20 is still the target. We have 38 confirmed users today, but I asked for 42 because finance and two operations managers will need access by June.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That makes sense. The quote has 42 standard seats at $96 per seat per month, billed annually, so the subscription total is $48,384 for the year. Implementation is a one-time $6,500.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And that includes the two admin training sessions we talked about?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It does. Two remote admin sessions, one end-user webinar, and configuration support for the first three workflows. If you add a fourth workflow before launch, that would be scoped separately.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Fair. On the contract term, procurement asked whether we can do a 12-month initial term instead of 24. They don't want to commit past this budget cycle.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so I updated it to 12 months. The per-seat price stays the same at 42 seats. The only thing is the renewal language is annual after that, with 60 days' notice if you don't want to renew.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That should be fine. For invoicing, can you split it into subscription and implementation as separate line items? Same invoice is okay, just separate lines.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, that's already reflected. Billing would issue one invoice on signature, net 30, with the subscription and implementation broken out separately.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send me the final order form and I'll route it today. If legal doesn't change anything, we should be able to sign by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I'll send the order form in the next hour, and I'll hold the kickoff slot for Tuesday, May 6, at 10 a.m. Eastern.
